geographic_scope: national roster (50 states, DC, and territories; includes Hawaii and Puerto Rico); a conus subset is provided via the geography dimension
active_in_year_definition: board_certified_active: urps_subspecialty_cert_year <= Y and not retired by Y, within the geography. Keyed on the URPS SUBSPECIALTY certification year (training-accurate, post-fellowship), NOT the primary cert_year. ABOG uses the real sub1startdate (2013+); ABU and unmatched ABOG use a fellowship proxy (primary + 2 urology / + 3 OB-GYN). 33 providers whose URPS cert/proxy postdates 2023 are excluded from the 2023 active count. The canonical 2023 national board-certified active count is 1,306 (1,339 is the roster_snapshot headcount).
deduplication_rule: ABOG = OB/GYN board-certification (FPMRS/URPS) pathway. ABU enters only as NET-NEW to the ABOG NPI set; dual-boarded general-urology-primary providers held out; reinstated dual-boarded (n=38) kept; retired/unmatched dropped. Active ABOG and ABU NPI sets are provably disjoint (asserted).
git_commit_semantics: source-parent (convention 2): the source-only commit these artifacts were regenerated from; the artifact bytes live in a separate child commit
source_description: Publicly accessible ABOG physician-certification information, integrated with other public physician-practice sources and independently reconciled for workforce research. ABOG did not supply, license, or endorse this derived dataset.

source_systems.practice_geography: CMS NPPES / DAC public practice-location data

retired_cells.note: v2.1.0 used the PRIMARY board cert basis: national 1,332 / CONUS 1,329. Those are RETIRED historical cells, not competing estimates. Contract 3.0.0 canonical = 1,306 / 1,303 (URPS subspecialty cert basis).

detail.model_baseline_year: not set here (cliff chooses its baseline measure explicitly)

cohort_definition.description: training-accurate URPS subspecialty certification year (ADDED step 1; active_2023 and the counts still use the PRIMARY cert_year at this step)

fallbacks.abu_all: primary urology cert_year + 2 (2-year fellowship; ABU subspecialty date not yet sourced)

provider_snapshot.grain: one row per identified URPS provider (unique npi)

known_limitations: Upstream classification (in_model_baseline / status) originates in the base rosters cliff/data/{abog,abu}_all_urps_2026-07-22.csv, currently UNTRACKED with NO committed producer. Primary remediation (docs/CHARTER_URPS_SSOT.md).
in_model_baseline disagrees with credentials.retirement_consensus for 48 providers; in_model_baseline is the authority.

3 identified providers are outside the contiguous US (1 HI ABOG, 1 PR ABU, 1 HI ABU); the conus geography drops them. All 3 are certified <= 2023. 26 providers get their state via the NPPES business-state fallback (see geography_resolution_rule).

board_certified_active is keyed on urps_subspecialty_cert_year (URPS subspecialty cert, training-accurate/post-fellowship): ABOG real sub1startdate (2013+); ABU and 47 unmatched ABOG use a fellowship proxy (primary +2 urology / +3 OB-GYN). 33 providers whose URPS cert/proxy postdates 2023 are excluded from the 2023 active count (present in roster_snapshot). The entire ABU arm is on the proxy until real ABU subspecialty dates are sourced (step 2). 196 proxy values predate 2013 (retained per PI: these physicians were practising urogynecology before formal subspecialty boards existed).
Pre-2023 board_certified_active is the certification build-up of the identified cohort (survivorship-biased for historical years); a true entries-and-exits panel is delegated to cliff.
latitude/longitude are NA (source rosters carry county/ZCTA/tract, not point coordinates); geocoding is a documented follow-up.
